items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field, such as technical writing, multimedia studies, graphic design, marketing or education, portfolio of relevant materials

Under the supervision of the Associate Dean for Admissions and Student Programs, the Veterinary Outreach and Pathway Coordinator works on programming to increase the number of California students in primary, secondary and undergraduate levels to become interested in pursuing a career in livestock veterinary medicine. Programs include the Farmvet2b internships for high school students and undergraduate Summer Enrichment Program, Dairy Vet, and Summer Livestock Experience Programs. Duties include creating informational and promotional materials, maintaining a database of potential high schools for outreach events, attending outreach events, and coordinating program operations, including participant travel.
Familiarity with various software tools to produce promotional materials and to maintain a database.
Demonstrated oral and written communication skills.

Skilled in organizational and program or event management, with the ability to effectively meet deadlines, prioritize competing demands, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and adapt to changing priorities.
Ability to work well on a team as well as work independently with general direction from supervisor.
